channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deixa, sem falar, QG de campanha em que reuniu aliados
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RN), a pre-candidate for president, left the property used as his campaign headquarters without speaking after an emergency meeting with allies. He departed in his car, avoiding any press statements. The move comes amid speculation about his candidacy and internal PL party maneuvers.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pedia dinheiro dos fundos sujos do 'irmão' Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is accused of soliciting money from so-called 'dirty funds' linked to his 'brother' Vorcaro, within a network of alliances with families tied to militias and violence. Despite these corruption allegations and associations with illegal groups, he maintains around 40% support in polls for the 2026 Brazilian presidential race.

item.title: Campanha “Título em Dia” alcança mais de 549 milhões de visualizações no Kwai
item.description: The 'Título em Dia' campaign, led by the TSE in partnership with Kwai from April 13 to May 3, reached over 549.5 million views in seven days. It generated 392,529 posts using the hashtag #TituloEmDia and leveraged Kwai’s strategic tools, including a dedicated page, push notifications, promotional banners, and placement in search and trends. The campaign page received 497,385 views, peaking at 147,185 views on April 15.

item.title: Dino pede providências sobre controle de emendas parlamentares
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino has ordered control bodies such as the TSE, TCU, CGU, Senate, and state legislative assemblies to provide information on the monitoring of parliamentary amendments, in response to requests from civil society organizations warning of possible misuse of funds during the electoral period. The TCU has five business days to report on the functioning of the amendments monitoring panel, and the CGU has ten business days to report on its operational capacity to conduct audits. State legislative assemblies have 30 calendar days to submit supporting documents.

item.title: A lacuna na versão de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre áudio para Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro did not explain his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro when stating he sought only private sponsorship for a film about Jair Bolsonaro, without public funds or quid pro quo. The Federal Police has indicated that Vorcaro sought proximity with public figures to shield himself from investigations or gain advantages in his businesses, revealing a broader pattern that Bolsonaro’s version fails to address, leaving a gap in his defense.

item.title: Confira a pauta de julgamentos do TSE desta quinta-feira (14)
item.description: The TSE will rule on Thursday (14) on six cases, including appeals regarding the rejection of campaign accounts for female city council candidates in Santo Antônio do Tauá (PA) in the 2024 elections. One case involves Aline Ruth Miranda Ataíde, whose campaign accounts were rejected by the TRE-PA, with a ruling to repay R$ 1,041.38 to the National Treasury. The session will be broadcast live starting at 10 a.m. via Rádio e TV Justiça and the TSE’s YouTube channel.

item.title: Romeu Zema diz que áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro é “imperdoável”
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) strongly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) after an audio surfaced in which he asked businessman Daniel Vorcaro for money to fund the film "Dark Horse", about Jair Bolsonaro. Zema called the request "imperdoável" and a "slap in the face of decent Brazilians," stating that lack of credibility undermines the ability to change Brazil. He also noted that despite criticizing Lula and the PT, Flávio Bolsonaro replicates similar practices, disqualifying him as an ethical leader.

item.title: Silveira pede ajuda ao setor privado para baixar preço da gasolina
item.description: Minister Alexandre Silveira urged the private sector to accelerate the pass-through of government fuel subsidies to lower gasoline prices, stating that companies like Vibra, Raízen and Ipiranga must contribute to the national civic effort amid international oil price pressures from the Iran war. The subsidies range from R$0.40 to R$0.45 per liter of gasoline, costing R$1–1.2 billion monthly, with a maximum cap of R$0.89 per liter. For diesel, the government will replace PIS/Cofins tax exemption with a subsidy starting in June, estimated at R$1.7 billion per month.

item.title: Áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro vira meme nas redes sociais
item.description: Leaked audio and messages attributed to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro show him demanding overdue payments of US$24 million from Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro. The content went viral as memes on social media, including AI-generated images of Romeu Zema in a Brazilian national team jersey. The case reignites debate over private financing of political films and banker influence in electoral campaigns.

item.title: Flávio nega ter recebido vantagens de Vorcaro e pede CPI do Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) denied receiving illicit advantages from banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating that funds received were solely for sponsoring the film 'Dark Horse' about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. He called for the installation of the CPI Master to 'separate the innocent from the criminals' after Intercept reported messages and audio indicating negotiations for US$2 million for the film. PL allies sought to downplay the scandal, framing it as legitimate sponsorship, though the campaign acknowledged the association with Vorcaro is electorally toxic.

item.title: De 'baixíssimo orçamento' a milhões pedidos a Vorcaro: os bastidores do filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro admitted requesting R$ 134 million from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, in November 2025 to finance sponsorship installments for the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 stabbing. The request was made shortly before Vorcaro's arrest in the Banco Master financial fraud scandal. Flávio denies receiving any benefits and insists the film is privately funded, with no public money or Rouanet law involvement.

item.title: Governistas comemoram (com cautela) áudios entre Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Government supporters reacted cautiously to an audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked businessman Daniel Vorcaro for money to finance a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, interpreting it as a sign of opposition weakness. The episode reignited debate over the direction of the bolsonarist candidacy in 2026, with analysts noting the funding request reveals difficulties in mobilizing independent resources. The audio, reported by O Globo, was welcomed in government circles as an opportunity to undermine the opposition’s narrative of strength.

item.title: Caiado cobra explicações de Flávio sobre financiamento do filme “Dark Horse”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) demanded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) explain the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' by banker Daniel Vorcaro, following the release of an audio in which Flávio pressures Vorcaro for payments related to the production. The statement came on Wednesday, the 13th, after a report by The Intercept Brasil. Caiado stressed the need for transparency amid suspicions of irregularities.

item.title: Financiado por Vorcaro, filme sobre Bolsonaro teve set fiscalizado após relatos de atraso em pagamento e comida estragada
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro and financed by Daniel Vorcaro, faced allegations of poor working conditions on set, including delayed pay, spoiled food, bathroom restrictions, and excessive hours, according to extras. At least 14 extras threaten to sue the producers, claiming they were surprised by the film’s topic and felt uncomfortable due to their opposition to Bolsonaro. The São Paulo State Union of Artists and Technicians in Entertainment (Sated-SP) confirmed the complaints and sent delegates to the set.

item.title: Esquerda explora revelação de contato de Flávio com Vorcaro por filme sobre o pai e retoma mote 'bolsomaster' nas redes
item.description: The Brazilian left seized on revelations of contact between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to criticize the senator and presidential pre-candidate, accusing him of involvement in a corruption scheme tied to funding a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The messages, leaked by The Intercept and confirmed by O Globo, were used to revive the 'Bolsomaster' narrative, with PT, PSOL, and other lawmakers demanding Federal Police investigations and even preventive detention of Flávio, framing the case as evidence that Bolsonarism and corruption are inherently linked.

item.title: Líder do PL na Câmara sai em defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘patrocínio privado’
item.description: The leader of the PL in the Chamber, Sóstenes Cavalcante, defended Flávio Bolsonaro after the senator admitted requesting 135 million reais from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro's life. The PL leadership stated the sponsorship was entirely private, with no public funds or Rouanet Law involvement, and rejected attempts to politicize the case. Investigations by the STF and reports from The Intercept Brasil suggest possible irregularities in the transfers, including the use of U.S.-based companies linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Como pré-candidatos de direita à Presidência reagiram ao áudio de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Right-wing presidential pre-candidates reacted to an audio leaked by Intercept Brasil in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sought financial support from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Romeu Zema (Novo) called the audio a 'slap in the face of decent Brazilians', Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) demanded transparency in public-private relations, and Renan Santos (Missão) accused Flávio of corruption, calling for his arrest and removal from office.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da MP que cria subsídios para gasolina e diesel
item.description: The Lula government announced subsidies for gasoline and diesel in response to fuel price increases caused by the Iran war. The measure, estimated to cost R$ 2.9 billion monthly, includes a subsidy of R$ 0.40 to R$ 0.45 per liter for gasoline and a monthly fiscal impact of R$ 1.7 billion for diesel. The Provisional Measure is available in PDF format.

item.title: Deputados pedem investigação sobre relação entre Vorcaro e Flávio
item.description: Federal deputies from PT, PSOL and PCdoB announced a complaint to the Federal Police, a request to the Federal Revenue Service, and a proposal for a parliamentary inquiry commission to investigate alleged negotiations between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about the Bolsonaro family, involving approximately R$134 million. Leaked messages show Flávio demanding payments, with part of the funds transferred between February and May 2025 to a U.S.-based fund linked to the lawyer of Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Oposição acusa PT de “criminalização política” e pede CPI do Banco Master
item.description: The opposition leadership in the Chamber of Deputies accused the PT of 'political criminalization' following the leak of audios involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro. The bloc defended the senator and called for a CPI to investigate Banco Master, claiming political motivations behind investigations targeting right-wing figures.

item.title: Áudio de Flávio terá impacto direto em candidatura, diz Erika Hilton
item.description: Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) stated that the leaked audio of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), in which he asks banker Daniel Vorcaro for money to produce the film Dark Horse, will directly impact his 2026 presidential campaign. She called the case an 'absurd corruption scandal' and suggested it reflects a broader pattern of illicit behavior by the Bolsonaro family. Flávio denies using public funds, saying the request was for private sponsorship only, and reaffirmed his support for a parliamentary inquiry into Banco Master.

item.title: Ouça Flávio pedindo dinheiro a Vorcaro para filme de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) negotiated with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, to finance the film “Dark Horse,” about Jair Bolsonaro’s trajectory, requesting $24 million in 2025, of which only $10.6 million was disbursed. He confirmed the authenticity of an audio in which he pressed for overdue payments, warning of negative consequences if payments were not made, including damaging the reputation of internationally renowned actors and directors. The funds were channeled through entities linked to the Grupo Entre, including the Havengate Development Fund LP in Texas, whose legal representative is associated with Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Carlos Viana protocola pedido de criação da CPMI do Banco Master
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (Podemos-MG) filed a request in Congress to create a CPMI (Parliamentary Inquiry Commission) on Banco Master following the release of an audio where Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) pressured banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film Dark Horse. The move aims to investigate potential irregularities linked to Banco Master and its ties to political figures.

item.title: Lindbergh pede prisão de Flávio por negociação com Vorcaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias requested the Federal Police to order the preventive arrest of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after audio leaks published by The Intercept Brasil revealed negotiations with banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about former President Jair Bolsonaro. Lindbergh argued that Flávio, as a free candidate, could interfere with investigations and also cited communications between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Vorcaro. Flávio denied any wrongdoing, stating the funds were used solely for a private audiovisual project about his father’s trajectory.

item.title: Governo Lula anuncia subvenção da gasolina e extensão parcial de benefício para diesel
item.description: The Lula government announced a gasoline subsidy of up to R$ 0.89 per liter, with estimated monthly costs between R$ 1 billion and R$ 1.225 billion, financed by increased revenues from dividends, royalties, and special participations. The measure will also partially extend the existing diesel benefit (R$ 0.32/liter) beyond May 31, effective June 1, using the same mechanism as MP 1340, without requiring additional fiscal compensation.

item.title: STF elege Dias Toffoli para vaga de Cármen Lúcia no TSE
item.description: The STF elected Minister Dias Toffoli to fill the vacancy left by Carmen Lúcia in the TSE, while the plenary also chose Flávio Dino as substitute minister. Both join Nunes Marques and André Mendonça, recently sworn in as president and vice-president of the TSE. The TSE’s composition balances STF, STJ, and advocacy representatives, with two-year mandates aimed at ensuring electoral impartiality and neutrality ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: 30 anos da urna eletrônica: Eleições 2024 foram o maior pleito informatizado do mundo
item.description: Brazil celebrated 30 years of electronic voting, highlighting the 2024 Municipal Elections as the world’s largest fully computerized election, with over 155 million eligible voters, 500,341 polling sections and 2 million poll workers involved. Technology enabled same-day vote counting and result publication, reinforcing the credibility and efficiency of Brazil’s electoral system. The TSE coordinated the operation through regional courts and electoral zones, with accessibility features in 178,501 sections.

item.title: 'É mentira, de onde tirou isso?': Flávio Bolsonaro chegou a negar ter pedido dinheiro a Vorcaro antes de vazamento
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro initially denied requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film Dark Horse, but later confirmed the request in a video while denying wrongdoing. Messages and an audio revealed by Intercept Brasil show he sought pending payments from the banker, who allegedly transferred R$ 61 million for the film’s production between February and May 2025. Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, is imprisoned over alleged financial fraud totaling up to R$ 12 billion.

item.title: “É preciso ter credibilidade para mudar o Brasil”, diz Zema sobre áudio de Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for president, criticized the leaked audio of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro demanding money from Daniel Vorcaro, saying it damages the lawmaker's credibility. He argued that changing Brazil requires credibility, which is undermined by such behavior.

item.title: Questionado sobre áudio em que Flávio Bolsonaro pede dinheiro a Vorcaro, Tarcísio não responde
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas declined to comment on an audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro pressured banker Daniel Vorcaro for funds to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, stating the topic was not on the agenda during a press briefing on the Jaguaré explosion. Intercept Brasil revealed that Vorcaro paid R$ 61 million for the film 'Dark Horse' between February and May 2025, with funds transferred to a U.S.-based fund linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro. Tarcísio, however, reiterated his demand for concessionaires to be held accountable for the explosion that left one person dead.

item.title: Mensagens de Flávio a Vorcaro viram munição para Lula, que já teve filme de sua vida alvo de delação
item.description: Messages from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to banker Daniel Vorcaro, revealed by Intercept Brasil, show requests for private funding to produce a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro, with negotiations for up to US$ 24 million and partial payments already made. The disclosure has been used as electoral ammunition by President Lula’s government, recalling a similar 2019 case involving a film about Lula’s life, based on testimony from Antonio Palocci in the Lava Jato probe. Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed the requests, stating he sought private sponsorship and met Vorcaro before public accusations against the banker emerged.

item.title: PL reafirma apoio à pré-candidatura de Flávio após áudio
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) issued a statement on Wednesday (13) reaffirming its support for the pre-candidacy of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) after The Intercept Brasil released an audio in which he requests financing from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse'. The party stated that Flávio's explanations were sufficient to maintain institutional backing.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro se defende, mas aliados admitem que proximidade com Vorcaro é um 'golpe forte' na campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is defending himself against allegations of involvement with Banco Master, proposing a parliamentary inquiry to investigate the case, but allies admit his proximity to banker Daniel Vorcaro is a 'strong blow' to his campaign. Audio and messages show he pressed for payments for a film about Jair Bolsonaro and expressed solidarity with Vorcaro, calling him 'brother,' contradicting his earlier claims of distance. Despite public defense by allies like Sóstenes Cavalcante, the private communications undermine the narrative that the relationship was purely private and devoid of public funds.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro negociou com Vorcaro R$ 134 milhões para filme sobre Jair
item.description: Messages and audio reveal a negotiation between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro for R$ 134 million in financing for the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic about former president Jair Bolsonaro. The deal involves private funding for a cinematic production aligned with the Bolsonaro family's political narrative.

item.title: Amazon, Shein e Shopee e outras lojas virtuais removem 'taxa das blusinhas' após decisão de Lula
item.description: AliExpress, Amazon, Magazine Luiza, Mercado Livre, Shein and Shopee removed the so-called 'blusinhas tax' on international purchases up to US$50 after President Lula signed a provisional measure that eliminates the federal tax in that range. The companies, certified under the Remessa Conforme program, stopped charging the tax, complying with the new federal rule. The change aims to reduce costs for consumers buying low-value imported goods.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro admite que procurou Vorcaro para recursos filme e nega que ofereceu vantagens
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) admitted he contacted Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Master, to seek funding for a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. He denied offering or receiving any advantages in exchange for the financial support. The statement comes amid speculation about his potential 2026 presidential candidacy.

item.title: Ouça áudio de Flávio Bolsonaro pedindo dinheiro a Vorcaro: ‘Fico sem graça de ficar te cobrando’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) confirmed he requested funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the production of the film 'Dark Horse', about the life of Jair Bolsonaro, stating he feels embarrassed to make the request but deems it necessary to avoid jeopardizing the project. The audio, disclosed by Intercept Brasil and confirmed by Estadão, shows Flávio expressing concern about negative consequences if the film is not completed, referencing potential 'default' on international figures like Jim Caviezel and Cyrus Nowrasteh. He reiterated he offered no benefits in return and called for a CPI on the Master case.

item.title: Em grupo, bolsonaristas debatem substituição de Flávio por Michelle, após áudio pedindo recursos para Vorcaro
item.description: Allies of Jair Bolsonaro are discussing replacing Flávio Bolsonaro with Michelle Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race after leaked audio showed the senator negotiating funds with banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a biopic. Ricardo Salles (NOVO-SP) stated in a WhatsApp group that if Flávio loses traction in polls, Michelle would be the ideal replacement. The revelation sparked division among supporters, with some preferring Lula’s re-election over backing Michelle, while the Bolsonaro campaign called an emergency meeting to assess the scandal’s impact on polling.

item.title: Tarcísio responsabiliza Sabesp e Comgás por explosão no Jaguaré
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas held Sabesp and Comgás accountable for the explosion in the Jaguaré neighborhood, stating that regulation would be enforced with a 'heavy hand', despite the state being a shareholder. He visited the affected area and pledged that the companies would be held responsible for the damages.

item.title: Governo diz que medidas sobre gasolina preservarão meta fiscal
item.description: The Lula government stated that measures to curb gasoline price increases, including subsidies of up to R$0.89 per liter, will not alter the fiscal target, as costs will be offset by higher revenue from oil dividends and royalties. Minister Bruno Moretti emphasized fiscal space exists to absorb the measures and that spending contingencies would be triggered if extraordinary revenues fall short, ensuring fiscal goals are met.

item.title: STF oficializa Dias Toffoli para compor TSE no lugar de Cármen Lúcia
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) symbolically approved the appointment of Minister Dias Toffoli as a titular member of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), replacing Carmen Lucía, who stepped down ahead of schedule. This completes the STF-originated bench in the TSE, now comprising Nunes Marques (president), Toffoli, and André Mendonça. The plenary also formally appointed Flávio Dino as a substitute member of the TSE.

item.title: PT aciona PF contra Flávio Bolsonaro após mensagens com dono do Banco Master
item.description: The leader of the PT in the Chamber, Pedro Uczai, announced that the party will file a complaint with the Federal Police and the Federal Revenue Service following the disclosure of messages attributed to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. The PT will request the lifting of banking and fiscal secrecy to investigate possible irregularities in the mentioned transactions.

item.title: Zanin acompanha Mendonça e vota por rejeitar ação sobre monitoramento de jornalistas e parlamentares
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin voted against the action challenging the Bolsonaro government's monitoring of journalists and parliamentarians, siding with André Mendonça's dissent. This brought the virtual trial's vote to 4-2 in favor of declaring the measure unconstitutional. Zanin argued that while monitoring dissidents to stifle public debate is unconstitutional, there is insufficient evidence that the acts were carried out with that illicit purpose, advocating for the dismissal of the Green Party's representation.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: o que é o filme que virou pivô da maior crise da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse' is an English-language biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, directed by Cyrus Nowrasteh and written by Mário Frias, starring Jim Caviezel as the former president. Flávio Bolsonaro sought private financing from banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to cover the film’s expenses, denying any use of public funds, though leaked audio shows him pressing for overdue payments and using familial language.

item.title: Explosão em SP: Tarcísio diz que ‘a mão pesada do Estado vai atuar e a punição vai acontecer’
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas visited the areas affected by the Sabesp explosion in Jaguaré, promised housing assistance, and stated that the State will enforce a 'heavy hand' to punish the concessionaire for failing to meet service targets, despite its privatization in July 2024. He emphasized that the State remains both a shareholder and regulator, and will hold concessionaires accountable, including applying contractual sanctions.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta que fake news sobre eleições miram urnas eletrônicas
item.description: A Projeto Confia research reveals that over 45% of election-related fake news in recent Brazilian electoral cycles targeted the functioning of electronic voting machines, exploiting public technical ignorance to sow distrust in the electoral system. Recurring false claims include alleged delays in the 'confirm' button and automatic number completion, with verification hindered by infrequent public contact with the machines (every two years). The study analyzed over 3,000 contents from the 2022 and 2024 elections, selecting 716 for qualitative analysis, aiming to build counter-narratives and rapid response strategies for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro, governistas pedem CPI do Master e quebra de sigilos de filho de Bolsonaro
item.description: Members of the government bloc in Congress have called for the immediate installation of a CPI to investigate alleged irregularities at Banco Master, following the release of an audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro negotiates with banker Daniel Vorcaro the transfer of $24 million to finance the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. PT leader in the Chamber, Deputy Pedro Uczai, also requested the breaking of Flávio Bolsonaro’s banking and fiscal secrecy, questioning the origin, tax declaration, and legality of the funds, as well as the close political and personal relationship between the senator and Vorcaro, who refer to each other as 'brother'.

item.title: 'Fala, irmãozão', 'estarei contigo sempre': veja mensagens entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Text messages between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro reveal pressure for payments tied to the production of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, with Vorcaro transferring R$ 61 million to a U.S.-based fund linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro. Flávio used informal terms like 'brother' and 'mermao' in the conversations, including audio messages and stickers, and said the film's positive impact could have an 'effect elevated to minus one'. The leak coincided with a spike in the dollar, which closed at R$ 5, and Flávio described the matter as 'private money' when questioned by reporters.

item.title: Tarcísio evita comentar áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro: “Não é pauta”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas declined to comment on the audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested financing from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the film Dark Horse, stating the matter is not on the agenda during a public event.

item.title: Deputada do PSOL aciona Mendonça e pede prisão preventiva de Flávio por tratativas com Vorcaro
item.description: Deputy Sâmia Bomfim (PSOL-SP) urged Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, rapporteur of the Master case, to assess the need for precautionary measures — including possible preventive detention — against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over negotiations with Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro.
